metrics.name: Net revenue, quarter to date
metrics.basis: Section subtotal of the FIN-05 ending balances on all 6 revenue accounts under R-SIGN convention 2, so the contra-revenue account subtracts rather than adds. Includes interest income and is net of discounts and credits.

metrics.name: Net loss, quarter to date
metrics.basis: Magnitude of the FIN-05 balance on account 3200 at the period end. The account is credit-normal, so its ending_balance cell is negative and the figure published here is its ending_debit. No sign convention is applied to a balance.

metrics.name: Net revenue, March 2026
metrics.basis: Sum over FIN-24's revenue lines of actual_amount times section_sign, R-SIGN convention 2. A naive sum of actual_amount returns 4245474.82, which is high by twice the contra line.

metrics.name: Cost of revenue, March 2026
metrics.basis: Sum over FIN-24's cost of revenue lines of actual_amount times section_sign, R-SIGN convention 2. Every line in the section carries section_sign 1, so the subtotal and a naive sum agree here.

metrics.name: Operating expense, March 2026
metrics.basis: Sum over FIN-24's operating expense lines of actual_amount times section_sign, R-SIGN convention 2. Every line in the section carries section_sign 1. Posting timing: FIN-05 is the pre-close trial balance and does not reflect the FIN-09 close batch, which debits 94279.18 to account 6020 Employee Benefits across 5 accrual lines. That line reads 5.86 percent under budget on FIN-24 and turns unfavorable once the batch is reflected, so a narrative that reads it as a reduction in spending on people is reading a posting date.

metrics.name: Net loss, March 2026
metrics.basis: Period movement of the FIN-05 balance on account 3200, and equal to net revenue less cost of revenue less operating expense for the month as published above. No sign convention is applied to a period movement on a single account.

metrics.name: Gross margin, March 2026
metrics.basis: Net revenue less cost of revenue over net revenue, both taken as section subtotals under R-SIGN convention 2. Under a naive sum of FIN-24's actual_amount it reads 81.28.

metrics.name: Cash and equivalents at 2026-03-31
metrics.basis: Sum of the FIN-05 ending balances on the 4 accounts the chart marks as cash. All four are debit-normal asset accounts, so no sign convention applies.

metrics.name: Net change in cash, March 2026
metrics.basis: FIN-05 beginning balances less ending balances across the same cash accounts, so a positive figure is a reduction in cash over the month. Stated as a movement rather than as a balance.
metrics.source_reference: beginning_balance less ending_balance where subtype is cash

metrics.name: Accounts receivable, subledger
metrics.basis: FIN-04's own subledger total at the same as-of date. The subledger stands above FIN-05's control account, and this pack publishes the subledger because that is the figure the receivable metrics are computed on.

metrics.name: Accounts receivable over 90 days
metrics.basis: The open balance FIN-04 carries in its oldest aging bucket. A bucket total, not a subtotal, so no sign convention applies.

metrics.name: Deferred revenue, current and non-current
metrics.basis: Sum of the FIN-05 ending balances on accounts 2300 and 2310. Both are credit-normal liabilities and both are published as positive magnitudes, which is the balance-sheet caption rather than a signed subtotal.
